title: Young Adults Now Cohabit More Than They Marry
hook: Living together is replacing marriage as the first serious commitment.
closing: Marriage is no longer the automatic starting point for building a shared life.
question: Would you live together before marrying?

segments.say: 9 percent of young adults live with an unmarried partner. That now exceeds the share living with a spouse.
The married share for young adults fell to 40 percent. Cohabitation grew as marriage stopped being the automatic next step.
Cohabiting adults over 50 reached 4.2 million. The same shift now extends beyond the youngest generation.
